verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents an IM Gateway and Messenger integrations for Telegram, Slack and Discord, so inbound-message gating is a fair question for it. However, no evidence describes sender allowlists, DM policies or mention gating on those channels. SSO login providers control access to the web app, not who can message the assistant, so they are an adjacent control and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
